case.title: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor

Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 5 days). Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
message.body:
Dear Mr Stadler,

You wrote that you want to keep supporting our operations with reliable delivery, and we would like to build on that. Option A below gives your plant a binding volume over a long term, which is business on top of what you supply us today and keeps your capacity steadily loaded.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives Leitner & Sohn a committed volume across the full contract term, and the claims below show why the price in it is the right one for both family companies.

On the cost side:
Our forecast for Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8, zinc rises 6.0% (fc:360010@2026-09).

On our past orders of the bolt:
Our orders of Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8, zinc with you were placed at EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2024-09-30 (po:4500011486-10), EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2025-05-26 (po:4500012506-10), EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2026-01-26 (po:4500013479-10) and EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2026-09-30 (po:4500014475-10): the price has been unchanged.

On our past orders of the nut:
Our orders of Hex nut ISO 4032 M12 8, zinc with you were placed at EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2024-09-30 (po:4500011486-20), EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2025-06-02 (po:4500012538-10), EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2026-01-30 (po:4500013504-10) and EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014466-10): the price has been unchanged.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.18; payment 90 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.13; payment 45 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.15; payment 60 days net; contract term 36 months.
Binding volume in every option: 30,000 units a year over 36 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. Since this goes beyond a routine price request, we would be grateful if you would take Option A to the person at your company who decides on pricing and volume. For them, the point is simple: Option A secures a binding volume with us for the whole term, and we are ready to confirm it at once.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
message.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We have carefully reviewed your data and the proposed commitment of 30,000 units annually over 36 months. While the prices in your options are not feasible, we can offer EUR 5.58 per unit based on your Option B with 45 days payment. This adjustment reflects the verified volume increase while maintaining sustainable terms for our continued partnership. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Our current offer stands at a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months. Valid for 30 days. Alternatively, we offer a price of €5.58 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 36 months.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
